meta.note: Version 2 is a redesign, not a mirror of the site. The palette is sampled from logo.png (indigo #3000d8 / #4800f0, violet #6000f0, magenta #a830f0, night #000048) instead of the Stripe-derived tailwind colours. The fire reds come from chaos_formula.html. Orange and yellow were removed on request.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: The brand colour, taken from the logo flame. Primary buttons, links, active states, focus rings, card numbers. 7.2:1 on surface and 6.1:1 on violet-tint, so it holds as text anywhere light; white on it is 7.2:1.

tokens.name: violet-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of violet fills. White on it is 9.5:1.

tokens.name: violet-bright
tokens.usage: Violet on night: links, numbers and the flame-glow core. 4.8:1 on night, fine for text 16px and up.

tokens.name: violet-200
tokens.usage: Card border on hover, input focus border tint, dividers inside violet-tint panels.

tokens.name: violet-tint
tokens.usage: Chips, the numbered tile background, selected rows, the hero mark panel's glow edge. Pair with violet text.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: The flame tip from the logo. The middle stop of the flame gradient and the highlighted word in headlines (gradient text). 5.0:1 on surface; decorative on night (3.7:1).

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The pale pink-lilac halo around the logo flame. The outer stop of light-section flame glows. Never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and strong text: a violet-black, never navy or pure black. 18.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on light surfaces. 9.1:1 on surface, 8.5:1 on surface-soft.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: categories, captions, footer legal line. 5.5:1 on surface, so it passes AA (the old slate-60 did not).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background, inputs, cards that sit on surface-soft.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Lavender-white. Default card fill on white pages and alternate section bands.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders at rest, header rule. Decorative (1.3:1).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and the language switch track, where the edge marks a control.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The deep indigo of the logo's box. Night sections (the Formula manifesto, the join block, the footer), toasts and the hero mark panel. The flame glows on it.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles on night.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Headings and body on night. 15.4:1.

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night. 7.6:1.

tokens.name: night-line
tokens.usage: The isometric line grid and hairlines on night.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal scrim, with an 8px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The spark: a hot rose-red used in tiny doses. Live dots, the 'New project' chip and the last stop of the fire gradient. 4.7:1 on surface for small bold text; on night use it only as a dot.

tokens.name: fire-red
tokens.usage: Chaos Formula accent: nav link, links and highlighted words on project pages. 6.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: fire-deep
tokens.usage: Chaos Formula primary button fill and callout rule. White on it is 8.3:1.

tokens.name: fire-ruby
tokens.usage: Chaos Formula button hover.

tokens.name: fire-night
tokens.usage: Chaos Formula's version of night: the project banner and the project hero panel.

tokens.name: fire-tint
tokens.usage: Chaos Formula soft panels and chip background.

tokens.name: fire-border
tokens.usage: Chaos Formula card and chip borders.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The H1. Unbounded's wide letters carry the brand; set it in ink with at most one word in flame gradient. Steps 34 / 44 / 52 / 60px.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: H2 at the start of every section. 28px on mobile. No split two-colour headline: the explanation goes in a lead paragraph below.

styles.name: number

styles.name: card-title-display

styles.name: quote

styles.name: title
